## Parties

This Mutual Confidentiality Agreement is entered into by and between Pinecastle Logistics Ltd ("First Party") and Wicker Gate Software Inc ("Second Party"), each referred to individually as a "Party" and together as the "Parties". This Agreement takes effect on 25 November 2026 (the "Effective Date") and is entered into in connection with a joint pilot of a routing tool (the "Purpose").

## Confidential Information

"Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party") in connection with the Purpose, whether disclosed orally, in writing, electronically, visually or by inspection of tangible objects, and whether or not marked or identified as confidential at the time of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, without limitation, routing algorithms, source code, technical data, specifications, designs, test results, operational and logistics data, pricing, customer and supplier information, business plans, and the existence and contents of the discussions between the Parties regarding the Purpose. Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession, free of any obligation of confidence, before disclosure by the Disclosing Party; (c) is lawfully received from a third party free to disclose it; or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Confidential Information.

## Obligations

Each Receiving Party shall hold the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall use it solely for the Purpose. The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party, except to its employees, officers, directors, professional advisers and contractors who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set out here; the Receiving Party remains responsible for their compliance. The Receiving Party shall apply at least the same degree of care it applies to its own confidential information of like importance, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care. The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorised use or disclosure of which it becomes aware. Where disclosure is required by law, regulation or court order, the Receiving Party may disclose only the portion legally required, giving the Disclosing Party prompt written notice where lawfully permitted. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information in its possession.

## Term

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a term of 42 months.

## Governing Law

This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by and construed in accordance with the law of the State of New York.
